test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following options is NOT correct regarding Swachh Bharat Abhiyan?

options.text: The main goal of the campaign was to eradicate the practice of open defecation.
It was launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in the year 2014
It is the restructuring of Nirmal Bharat Abhiyan
It's main focus is achieving cleanliness only in urban areas of India

solution:
The correct answer is** It's main focus is achieving cleanliness only in urban areas of India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__​​​**

__
 
• The government of India launched the** Swachh Bharat Abhiyan, a nationwide effort, in 2014 **to end open defecation and enhance solid waste management.
 
• The** Government of India **is conducting a nationwide drive to clean the nation's streets, highways, and** infrastructure in 4041 statutory towns.**
 
• **Clean India Mission for Cities. **The program includes eradicating open defecation, converting unhygienic toilets to pour flush toilets, eliminating manual scavenging, managing municipal solid waste, and changing people's attitudes toward good sanitation practices. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Swachh Bharat Mission **was established by the** Indian Prime Minister on October 2, 2014**, to focus on sanitation and to speed up efforts to attain universal sanitation coverage.
 
• For the** fifth year running, Indore has held the title of "Cleanest City" **in India without being contested, winning the prized designation at the **Swachh Survekshan Award 2021**.
 
• The** National Tricolor** is used to represent the** bridge of Mahatma Gandhi's spectacles in the Swachh Bharat Mission logo.**
